groups.brief: Pre-study R9-FR-1 round 2 (2026-10-05, under tvofi's 2026-10-04 R9-FR-1 brief; measured at 86dbf0ca; evidence in the round-2 pre-study document on branch handoff/r9-friction-study): #1951, the typing share. The workstation seat recipe builds the pinned typing interpreter the cloud recipe already builds, so a Mac seat's scoped gate checks the mypy census before the handoff instead of CI's typing job finding it after. Measured: tools/audit/seat/cloud-setup.sh:61-68 "HPO_TYPING_PYTHON" builds venv-ha from tests/requirements-typing.txt and exports HPO_TYPING_PYTHON; tools/audit/seat/seat_venv.sh builds venv-ci only and tools/audit/seat/shims/seat-python execs venv-ci with nothing exported, so tests/typing_ruler.py on a Mac seat prints its census-not-checked skip line and passes while the census goes unmeasured. #1958 and #1959 were Mac seats blocked root-cause-unanswered on typing in the v6.7.16 window, and #1959's own Red-checks answer names this gap. Scope: seat_venv.sh gains the venv-ha build with cloud-setup.sh's exact pins call (hash-pinned, --no-deps) and its homeassistant version assertion; --check reports it; the shims export HPO_TYPING_PYTHON pointing at it only when it exists and the variable is unset, never overriding a value the seat set. Do not edit tests/typing_ruler.py, tests/run.sh or tests/closure.py: they are code-owned, and the ruler's PINNED_ENV contract does the rest once the variable is set. Acceptance, failing first: at the base, the shim-run ruler prints the not-checked line; at the head with venv-ha built it checks the census; null control: with venv-ha absent at the head the shim exports nothing and the not-checked line returns. Measure the venv-ha disk footprint with du and state it in the body: the environment family's Mac disk-full entries are this change's risk. Instrument in tools/, no policy-file edit. Body: Part of #1951 (R9-FR-12 is the other part), re-measurement command node .claude/workflows/policy_lint.mjs --stats --since <the tag after this merge>.

resume.next_step: failing acceptance first (the not-checked line at the base), then the venv-ha build, then the null control

groups.brief: Pre-study R9-FR-1 round 2 (2026-10-05, under tvofi's 2026-10-04 R9-FR-1 brief; measured at 86dbf0ca; evidence in the round-2 pre-study document on branch handoff/r9-friction-study): #1951, the budget-raise-gate and no-copies shares. tools/audit/prepr.sh predicts two head reds offline, before the push that would produce them. Why not R9-FR-2's arm again: every root-cause-unanswered block in the v6.7.16 window named a red standing at the reviewed head, and the ancestry arm reads only commits already pushed (tools/audit/prepr.sh:579-581 "no commit of this branch"), so it cannot see the first block on a red by construction. (a) Budget raise: compute the diff's raises with file_raises from .claude/workflows/budget_raise_gate.py read at the merge base (the copy CI's gate restores), offline, with no review lookup; when any raise exists, the pr-body step's body check receives one extra --red budget-raise-gate, so a body whose Red checks section does not name it is refused before the push. It is the same body check pr-contract runs, fed one more name, not a second implementation. (b) Copy claim: when the diff touches a .py file under tests/ or custom_components/, run python3 tests/closure.py no-copies, the step .github/workflows/tests.yml:1818 "no-copies" runs in the closures job, and refuse on its failure. Both arms skip, never refuse, when their input is absent, and print that boundary. Do not edit .claude/workflows/budget_raise_gate.py or tests/closure.py (code-owned): call them. Extend --self-test, failing first: a diff raising a budget leaf with a silent body refuses; the same diff with the body naming the gate passes (null control); a diff touching no budget file passes; a test file defining a production top-level name refuses, and renamed it passes. State the no-copies wall time on the seat host in the body (the pre-study measured 11.8 to 27.7 s on a loaded Mac). Raise in the body, for the owner, that .claude/rules/defect-root-cause.md's Qualifies example says the no-copies countermeasure was built as an edit-time hook while no hook, prepr step or run.sh line ran it at 86dbf0ca; rewording that example is a policy edit this PR does not make. No policy-file edit. Body: Part of #1951 (R9-FR-11 is the other part), re-measurement command node .claude/workflows/policy_lint.mjs --stats --since <the tag after this merge>.

resume.next_step: failing self-test fixtures first, then arm (a), then arm (b), then the null controls
